description: Answer a question by quoting a published wiki article, or — when the question names one country, programme, tax regime, bank or legal form and asks one of its reviewed questions — with the reviewed structured answer and its verbatim official quotation. Never generated at request time; always carries the URL it came from. Returns confident=false with suggested reading when the corpus does not cover the question or when context genuinely conflicts. When the question names one reviewed object and several of its reviewed questions fit the wording without a confident match, the answer (if any) is an ordinary article quotation and structuredResolution carries the clarification: question_ambiguous with candidate topics and their admission state. A question naming several distinct reviewed objects, or mapped to one reviewed topic whose answer is withdrawn or held, returns confident=false, refusalReason structured_held and no article text; ask about one object or use answer_compare. Bare MSO means the Hong Kong Money Service Operator licence; use Management Services Organization or regulated-practice context for the broader platform concept. Ask in the language you want answered — Russian and English are both first-class.
